plans.goal: seal Maud in the back chapel where she can heal without interruption
steps: push through the stone corridors and claim the inner chamber
ring the bell to rattle them and disrupt their coordination
hold the doorways while Pip grabs the reliquary

atoms.text: All of us move up through the chapel—we stay tight and don't let them separate us
Ring the chapel bell—Silas and his crew are rattled, we use the confusion to push forward
Maud, hold the inner chamber—Borin and I stand in the doorways so nothing gets to you
Pip, slide in and grab the reliquary while we hold them off—it's light, you can move fast
Borin, stand on the left passage—no one comes through without going through you
I'm braced in the main doorway, shield ready—if Marl or Dace charges, they hit solid ground

plans.goal: use the pillar to crush Marl and control the central altar
steps: maneuver Marl into position near the leaning pillar
topple it and crush him, then hold the altar as a strongpoint
keep Maud healing from safety while we control the high ground

atoms.text: Borin and I move to the altar—we want Marl charging at us, not at Maud
Topple the pillar—Marl goes flat, and we have crushing cover on the high altar
This altar is ours—Pip, flank left. Borin, take the right. I'm in the middle, no one passes
Ivo's got us in the open—Maud, stay behind that crate and keep your head down while healing
Pip, if Dace or Silas breaks left, hit them from the flank—we're all watching the same exits
Once we have the relic, we're moving south fast—I'll ready to block any pursuit

plans.goal: aggressive rush—Pip gets the relic while we overwhelm them
steps: Borin and I charge the archer and leader to distract them
Pip darts in and grabs the reliquary during the confusion
we form a wedge and push out together

atoms.text: Borin, we're going straight at Silas and Ivo—no mercy, full pressure
Pip, the relic is yours—dash to the altar and grab it, we'll cover you
Maud, follow Pip but stay behind—if anyone gets near her, I'm there
Dace will try to intercept Pip—I shove him into the brazier, he's out for a moment
Once Pip has it, we're moving south together—tight formation, shields up, no one breaks rank
I'm ready to block anyone who gets between us and the exit
